reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: New Hampshire
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for nonpayment of rent?
*/

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Scenario facts (question)      */
/* ----------------------------- */

% Parties
tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

% A possessory (eviction) action based solely on nonpayment of rent.
possessory_action(a1).
action_tenant(a1, t1).
action_landlord(a1, l1).
based_solely_on_nonpayment_of_rent(a1).

% Hearing on the merits date (modeled as an integer day count).
hearing_on_merits_day(a1, 30).

% Amounts due for a cure under RSA 540:9 I(a).
rent_due_through_time_of_payment(a1, 1000).
other_lawful_charges_in_lease(a1, 50).
filing_fee_incurred(a1, 150).
service_charges_incurred(a1, 60).
liquidated_damages_amount(15).

% Tenant's attempt to cure: timely tender of a municipal/state/federally-funded voucher payment.
% Modeled as a "written promise to pay on behalf of the tenant" (RSA 540:9-a I).
tendered_payment(a1, t1, l1, day(20), voucher_written_promise, 1275).

% Landlord refused the voucher tender.
payment_refused_by_landlord(a1).

% Tenant has not already used RSA 540:9 to defeat eviction 3 times in the last 12 months.
% (This matters for RSA 540:9 II; our scenario uses RSA 540:9-a defense, but we encode it.)
prior_cure_defeats_under_540_9_last_12_months(t1, 0).

/* Helper predicate summarizing the factual statement encoded above. */
scenario_statement :-
    possessory_action(A),
    action_tenant(A, T),
    action_landlord(A, L),
    based_solely_on_nonpayment_of_rent(A),
    hearing_on_merits_day(A, HearingDay),
    tendered_payment(A, T, L, day(TenderDay), voucher_written_promise, _Amount),
    TenderDay < HearingDay,
    payment_refused_by_landlord(A),
    prior_cure_defeats_under_540_9_last_12_months(T, PriorUses),
    integer(PriorUses),
    PriorUses >= 0.

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Statute translations           */
/* ----------------------------- */

% --- RSA 540:9 (2021) Payment After Notice ---

% RSA 540:9 I(a): Allowed forms include those specified in 540:9-a I.
% We model payment forms as atoms.
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(cash).
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(certified_check).
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(prepaid_money_order).
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(electronic_transfer).
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(guaranteed_funds).
statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(voucher_written_promise). % via reference to 540:9-a I

% RSA 540:9 I(a): Required cure amount = all rent due + other lawful charges + $15 + filing fee + service charges.
statute_540_9_required_cure_amount(Action, Required) :-
    rent_due_through_time_of_payment(Action, Rent),
    other_lawful_charges_in_lease(Action, Charges),
    liquidated_damages_amount(Liq),
    filing_fee_incurred(Action, Filing),
    service_charges_incurred(Action, Service),
    Required is Rent + Charges + Liq + Filing + Service.

% RSA 540:9 I(a): Timely cure payment must be "at any time prior to the hearing on the merits".
statute_540_9_timely_before_hearing(Action, day(Day)) :-
    hearing_on_merits_day(Action, HearingDay),
    Day < HearingDay.

% RSA 540:9 II: A tenant may not defeat an eviction for nonpayment by use of this section
% more than 3 times within a 12-month period.
% Interpreted as: the (next) use is permitted only if PriorUses < 3.
statute_540_9_use_permitted(Tenant) :-
    prior_cure_defeats_under_540_9_last_12_months(Tenant, PriorUses),
    PriorUses < 3.

% RSA 540:9 I (dismissal conditions) involves landlord filing receipt, but the key cure condition is payment.
% We encode a "qualifying cure payment" under 540:9 I(a) (ignoring filing/receipt mechanics because
% the question is about accepting the cure attempt, not court filing).
statute_540_9_qualifying_cure_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    based_solely_on_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    action_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    action_landlord(Action, Landlord),
    tendered_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord, Time, Form, Amount),
    statute_540_9_timely_before_hearing(Action, Time),
    statute_540_9_allowed_payment_form(Form),
    statute_540_9_required_cure_amount(Action, Required),
    Amount >= Required,
    statute_540_9_use_permitted(Tenant).

% --- RSA 540:9-a (2021) Payment by Voucher; affirmative defense ---

% RSA 540:9-a I: Voucher payments tendered by tenant (written promise to pay by state/county/municipality or org funds)
% "shall constitute payment by the tenant of the amount represented in the voucher".
statute_540_9a_voucher_constitutes_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord, Amount) :-
    tendered_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord, _Time, voucher_written_promise, Amount),
    Amount > 0.

% RSA 540:9-a I: "shall not be construed to obligate a landlord to accept partial rental payments."
% We encode a guard: this statute does not require accepting a tender that is less than the full cure amount.
statute_540_9a_is_partial_payment(Action, Amount) :-
    statute_540_9_required_cure_amount(Action, Required),
    Amount < Required.

% RSA 540:9-a II(a): Affirmative defense if tenant tendered timely payment pursuant to paragraph I and it was refused.
statute_540_9a_affirmative_defense_refused_voucher(Action, Tenant) :-
    based_solely_on_nonpayment_of_rent(Action),
    action_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    action_landlord(Action, Landlord),
    tendered_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord, Time, voucher_written_promise, Amount),
    statute_540_9_timely_before_hearing(Action, Time),
    statute_540_9a_voucher_constitutes_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord, Amount),
    payment_refused_by_landlord(Action),
    \+ statute_540_9a_is_partial_payment(Action, Amount).

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Reasoning about "must accept"  */
/* ----------------------------- */

% A landlord "must accept" the attempt to cure (for purposes of avoiding eviction for nonpayment)
% if the tenant has a legally effective cure/defense based on timely full tender/payment.
%
% We treat either of these as making refusal ineffective:
%  (1) a qualifying cure payment under RSA 540:9 I(a) (within the 3-times/12-month limit), or
%  (2) an affirmative defense under RSA 540:9-a II(a) for refused timely full voucher tender.
legal_landlord_must_accept_cure_attempt(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    statute_540_9_qualifying_cure_payment(Action, Tenant, Landlord),
    !.
legal_landlord_must_accept_cure_attempt(Action, Tenant, Landlord) :-
    statute_540_9a_affirmative_defense_refused_voucher(Action, Tenant),
    action_landlord(Action, Landlord),
    !.

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Answer                         */
/* ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    possessory_action(A),
    action_tenant(A, T),
    action_landlord(A, L),
    legal_landlord_must_accept_cure_attempt(A, T, L),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Main                           */
/* ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Must a landlord accept a tenant's attempt to cure for nonpayment of rent?
